conclusion: One retention-enabled target completed the preserved DBP37 startup route without device loss, while the old startup atlas remained bound through the former failure window. This strengthens a retirement/descriptor interaction lead but does not isolate it from corrected archived window geometry and current display/timing. The smallest next discriminator is one matching retention-OFF target with the same instrumented binary, corrected window configuration, actual client size, content and cache baseline; analyze before implementing or validating a production candidate.

expected_benchmark_output.classification: Mutable output of the preserved bench command, not an immutable runtime resource. Original lane opening is preserved without rewriting its earlier mistaken runtime classification.

prefix_interpretation: All admitted sequence slots 1..32768 are present, ordered and flushed. Frame7 records end at4568, far before the capacity ceiling; reported intervals contain only the startup memory/image binds, with no image or memory unbind in this prefix.

The collector reserves immutable slots in admission order, rejects new records once RecordLimit32768 is reached, and flushes only ready contiguous slots. The retained whole-page owner corroborates the prefix absence of retirement at frame6. No truncated multi-object payload or writer failure is visible in admitted records.

The total omissions and cutoff0 make whole-run binding capture incomplete. No claim about later frame1013..1491 or teardown unbinding is made. The experiment interprets the former frame7 startup failure window only, not full-run address completeness or unique fault cause.
A successful route is directly observed; the absence of a later recorded fault address cannot identify an executing shader or prove all descriptor/GPU bytes correct.
causal_limits: The original failing target used accepted PR100 source; this target uses the reviewed opt-in retention source and a separately pinned build.

The archived configuration changes only win_h1040->1032 and win_w1920->1918. Startup width/height arguments change nominal1904x1001->1902x993; actual viewport is1902x993 in both. Current display is2560x1440. These restorations preserve target viewport but can change window/session timing and were not tested by a matching retention-OFF target yet.

Retained old atlas overlaps the former reported read interval, but overlap alone is not a unique root cause. Invalid unused descriptors under PARTIALLY_BOUND do not alone prove an application Vulkan violation.
One successful experimental run is neither a production repair nor the three independent exact-reproducer successes required for acceptance.
CFX resource capture and address capture are bounded; later long-run resource/address omissions do not become unqualified completeness claims.
No driver/TDR/power/clock policy changes, renderer feature disablement or blanket synchronization were introduced by this review.

prospective_candidate_requirements: A bounded permanent float light fallback and unsigned-integer probe fallback must be format-compatible with sampler2D/usampler2D and explicitly initialized before shader-visible use.

Removed reserved light/probe pairs must be overwritten before retiring their views; new and retained current atlas pages keep their exact descriptor identities and contents. No dynamic material descriptors are touched.

Track actual previously-published page count rather than assuming current vector size covers removed slots. Shrink N->M rewrites exactly the removed interval [M,N); growth and equal-count replacement update current pairs.

Only overwrite a removed descriptor after pending submissions that could dynamically sample its old page generation have completed, or use a new descriptor-set generation retaining the previous set and images until their own fences retire. UPDATE_AFTER_BIND is not evidence that changing an actively-used page is semantically safe.

For the demonstrated startup transition, prior frames have completed their ordinary frame fence wait before BeginFrame map activation; prove this exact ordering in timeline/source and add no blanket device wait.
After descriptor writes are published, old view/image ownership follows the existing draw retirement list and completed-fence path; permanent fallback images outlive descriptor-set use.

An actual-owner/planner fixture must cover1->0,N->M,N->N replacement, growth, repeated shrink/grow,128-page boundary, invalid page count/capacity, stale-old-view rejection, and untouched dynamic range. It must pin initialization/publication/retirement order rather than merely mirror expected counts.

Classify any resulting default behavior as a renderer compatibility correction unless dynamic illegal access is demonstrated; do not claim PARTIALLY_BOUND unused descriptors were intrinsically invalid.
